title: Where does Orbit expose Prometheus metrics?
body: I want to scrape Orbit with Prometheus and alert on failed ingests. Which endpoint and port expose the metrics?
author: asker

answers.body:
Metrics are exposed at `/actuator/prometheus` on port 9404. Example scrape config:

```yaml
scrape_configs:
  - job_name: orbit
    metrics_path: /actuator/prometheus
    static_configs:
      - targets: ['orbit.example.internal:9404']
```
answers.author: dana
